error.account_mismatch: This does not match the account this integration was set up with.

reconfigure.title: Update your Emerald account
reconfigure.description: Re-enter your Emerald app password. The username cannot be changed here - remove and re-add the integration to use a different account.

auth_failed.title: Emerald rejected the saved credentials
auth_failed.description:
Emerald refused the credentials saved for {account} ({error}).

This is often a temporary problem at Emerald's end. Home Assistant keeps retrying, and this message clears itself once sign-in succeeds again.

If you have changed your Emerald password, open the Emerald Hot Water System integration, choose Reconfigure, and enter the new one.

awscrt_version_straddle.title: Emerald Hot Water System cannot connect: mixed awscrt versions
awscrt_version_straddle.description: The awscrt package used to talk to the Emerald cloud is loaded at two different versions in this Home Assistant process, which cannot be fixed without a restart. Select **Submit** to restart Home Assistant now, or restart manually later.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant to fix the Emerald connection
confirm.description: The awscrt package used to talk to the Emerald cloud is loaded at two different versions in this process. Restarting Home Assistant reloads it cleanly and clears the problem. Select **Submit** to restart now.
